title: Palmier Pro – Open-source macOS video editor built for AI
claim: Show HN: Palmier Pro – Open-source macOS video editor built for AI
why_good: An open-source macOS video editor built for AI-driven editing — rides the demand for faster, agent-assisted video production.
value: Freemium desktop + a pro/cloud-render tier for creators; video tools have proven willingness to pay.
risk: CapCut/Descript/Premiere with AI are entrenched; an open editor must nail the AI-editing UX to matter.

zh.claim: Show HN: Palmier Pro —— 为 AI 打造的开源 macOS 视频编辑器。
zh.why_good: 一个为 AI 驱动剪辑打造的开源 macOS 视频编辑器——踩在 更快、agent 辅助的视频制作 需求上。
zh.value: 桌面免费增值 + 给创作者的专业/云渲染档;视频工具有被验证的付费意愿。
zh.risk: 带 AI 的 CapCut/Descript/Premiere 根基深;开源编辑器要把 AI 剪辑体验做到位才有意义。
